claims: The Savannah Bananas brought their "Banana Ball" world tour to New Orleans for the first time on March 14–15, 2026.
The Savannah Bananas performed two sold-out nights at the Caesars Superdome.
The Savannah Bananas played against their rival team, the Party Animals.
The Caesars Superdome was specially configured for baseball.
Competitive baseball was played at the Caesars Superdome for the first time since 2004.
New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough made a surprise appearance.
Tyler Shough threw a touchdown during a game intermission.
Tickets for the shows sold out via an official lottery system.
The official lottery system closed in October 2025.
Tickets for 2026 were listed on SeatGeek.
Tickets for 2026 were listed on StubHub.
"Banana Ball" rules include a two-hour time limit.
"Banana Ball" rules include the ability for fans to catch foul balls for an out.
Taylor Swift sold out consecutive nights at the Caesars Superdome.
Beyoncé sold out consecutive nights at the Caesars Superdome.
